company.name: Carvice
company.shortDescription: Carvice platform connect car service centers and car owners with competitive prices, and guaranteed quality.
company.description: Carvice platform connects car service centers and car-owners with competitive prices, and guaranteed quality. The car owner requests quotations for the desired jobs, then he/she receives different quotations from different service centers along with a user-based rating. After the car owner accepts the desired quotation, he/she gets to choose a pick-up and delivery service if he/she desires. After the service completion is approved by both parties, the exact amount is charged and the service details are saved in the service history along with the bill to keep record and track.
